confirmation_contract.close_back_inside: first M15 bar at or after the sweep whose CLOSE is strictly inside the Asian range

displacement.rule: body / candle_range >= 0.70 AND body polarity matches the thesis

fresh_fvg.freshness: third candle closes strictly after the MSS bar close and within 12 M5 bars

mss_bos.rule: first direction-matched MSS or BOS at or after the displacement bar

retrace.invalidation: if the structural stop is touched before the FVG, the candidate is rejected
retrace.rule: first causal M5 touch of the FVG strictly after the gap's third candle closes

confirmation_contract.sweep: M15 bar trades beyond the Asian boundary on the non-direction side
confirmation_contract.temporal_envelope: every funnel event INCLUDING the entry fill must occur inside the session entry window

entry_contract.fill_policy: LIMIT_AT_FVG_PROXIMAL_EDGE_ON_FIRST_CAUSAL_TOUCH — fill price is the proximal FVG edge (upper edge for LONG, lower edge for SHORT) on the first M5 bar that trades into the gap strictly after the gap's third candle closes. Outcome measurement starts at the NEXT M5 bar; if the fill bar itself also trades through the structural stop the candidate is recorded STOPPED_SAME_BAR = -1R (fail-closed).
entry_contract.outcome_anchor: M5 bar AFTER the fill bar

execution_capability: NONE — no broker adapter, no order sending, no EA import

session_contract.note: Both evaluated session pairs use the SAME Asian reference range (00:00-06:00 UTC) as the liquidity object, because the hypothesis is Asian-liquidity displacement. The pair label names the ENTRY window: ASIAN_LONDON = London entry window 07:00-10:00 UTC, LONDON_NEWYORK = New York entry window 12:00-15:00 UTC. Windows are frozen and are NEVER widened in response to observed results.

sl_contract.note: Structural stop ONLY: LONG SL = sweep bar low, SHORT SL = sweep bar high. No pip/point buffer is added. Execution/spread buffering belongs to the friction layer, which has no authority in this mission.

target_contract.censoring_policy: RIGHT_CENSORED_DATA_BOUNDARY_EXPLICIT — a candidate whose 288-M5-bar outcome window is truncated by the DEVELOPMENT partition end is RIGHT_CENSORED: excluded from target-capability denominators, counted in the population, never imputed. The OOS partition is NEVER read to complete an outcome window.
target_contract.economic_claim: FORBIDDEN — no friction authority exists (structural R only)
target_contract.management_diagnostic: 50% at TP1, 50% toward TP2, original structural SL retained by the runner
target_contract.tp2: nearest valid H1 liquidity objective strictly beyond TP1 (closed H1 bars only)

trigger_contract.composite_rule: BULL iff D1==BULL and H4!=BEAR and H1==BULL; BEAR iff D1==BEAR and H4!=BULL and H1==BEAR; else NEUTRAL
trigger_contract.decision_anchor: entry window open (UTC); only bars CLOSED at or before the anchor are readable
primary_trigger: Asian liquidity swept on the opposite side
M15 close back inside the Asian range
recorded_but_non_gating: H1 liquidity pool counts above/below price
trigger_contract.sweep_side_rule: direction MUST NOT equal sweep side: BULL sweeps the Asian LOW, BEAR the Asian HIGH
